en.description: A local English–Traditional Chinese document handoff: pair chapters, inspect missing objects, and keep structural review separate from translation quality.

en.about_description: The maintenance relationship, privacy boundary and purpose of this bilingual Markdown project.
en.about:
A disclosed ecosystem project

Vesper2026 maintains this MIT-licensed tool and site within the same maintenance team as the related Eqvero, KolmoPDF and KomoPDF ecosystem. These notes are not an independent endorsement of those products.

The Python CLI reads two local Markdown files. It does not translate text or transmit documents. This static site contains tutorials and example downloads, not an upload processor, user account system or analytics service. GitHub hosts the pages; external links connect to their own services.

Where KolmoPDF fits

KolmoPDF's PDF-to-Markdown service can provide upstream Markdown from PDF documents. That is a separate cloud service that uploads the input document. This open-source comparison tool is not its proprietary parser, OCR engine or translation model.

The example chapter omission is deliberate. A structural difference calls for human review; it does not prove a translation is wrong.
en.footer: Vesper2026 · Local comparison, no semantic scoring · Affiliation disclosed

en.title: Compare English and Traditional Chinese Markdown without matching the words
en.description: Find a missing figure and unpaired Results section using two synthetic documents and a local index map.
en.body:
Translated headings rarely use the same words. A literal text diff turns every heading into a change, even when the chapter structure is intact. This exercise pairs chapter positions instead, then compares a small set of non-prose objects.

Run the two-document example

With Python 3.10 or newer, run from the repository root. No package installation is required.

python bilingual_map.py examples/source.md examples/zh-Hant.md --output examples/output

The English fixture has Methods and Results. Its Methods section contains an image target, a link, a Python fence and a standalone equation block. The Traditional Chinese fixture has 方法, the same link, code language and equation count, but intentionally omits the figure and Results. The image target is a symbolic test reference, not a rendered-image download.

1 section pairs; 1 source / 0 target unpaired. No semantic scoring.

Inspect the paired chapter

comparison.md pairs source index 1, Methods, with target index 1, 方法. Its review field is images. Source index 2, Results, appears separately as unpaired. The JSON report includes each chapter's starting line and exact object lists, so a reviewer can locate the difference.

Make a deliberate map

Pass --map examples/mapping.json to use the explicit pair [[1,1]]. For a reordered complete translation, a mapping such as [[1,2],[2,1]] pairs the intended chapters. Each index may appear only once. Read the headings before accepting an order-based comparison: a missing middle chapter can shift every later pair.

If your workflow starts with PDFs, KolmoPDF is the related cloud conversion step; it uploads the PDF. This utility only compares the resulting local Markdown. Equal structure says nothing about whether a sentence was translated correctly.

zh-Hant.title: 不比對字面翻譯，找出雙語 Markdown 的結構遺漏
zh-Hant.description: 用兩份合成文件與本機索引映射，找出缺少的圖片和未配對的結果章節。
zh-Hant.body:
翻譯後的標題通常不會使用相同字詞。直接做文字差異比對，即使結構完整，也會把每個標題標成變更。這個練習先按章節位置配對，再檢查少數非正文物件。

執行雙文件範例

準備 Python 3.10 或更新版本，在儲存庫根目錄執行，不必安裝套件。

python bilingual_map.py examples/source.md examples/zh-Hant.md --output examples/output

英文練習文件有 Methods 與 Results。Methods 包含圖片目標、連結、Python 程式碼圍欄及獨立公式區塊。繁中練習文件包含「方法」、相同連結、程式語言及公式數量，卻刻意省略圖片與結果章節。圖片目標只是測試用的文字引用，並非可下載的圖片成品。

1 section pairs; 1 source / 0 target unpaired. No semantic scoring.

查看已配對的章節

comparison.md 將原文索引 1「Methods」配對至譯文索引 1「方法」，待覆核欄位為 images；原文索引 2「Results」另列為未配對。JSON 報告保留各章節的起始行與物件清單，方便人工定位。

明確指定映射

加上 --map examples/mapping.json，即可使用明確配對 [[1,1]]。若完整譯文調換兩個章節，則可用 [[1,2],[2,1]] 指定真正對應關係。每個索引只能出現一次。接受順序比對前應先看標題，因為中間漏掉一節，後續配對就可能整體錯位。

若資料由 PDF 開始，相關的 KolmoPDF 雲端轉換會上傳 PDF；本工具只對照之後的本機 Markdown。結構相同不表示句子翻譯正確。

en.title: Stable section indices matter more than translated heading text
en.description: Understand empty headings, duplicate titles, preambles and the limited Markdown syntax before interpreting a report.
en.body:
The mapper uses encounter order, not a title slug, as a chapter identity. That decision avoids pretending that two translated words must match and makes repeated headings unambiguous.

The index contract

Recognized ATX headings receive indices 1, 2, 3 and so on, including nested headings. An empty heading such as # still receives an index and displays as “(untitled)” in the Markdown report. Two “Notes” headings are separate sections. Nonblank content before the first heading is section 0; a blank document has no sections. The default comparison pairs section 0 only with another section 0 and pairs the remaining headings in encounter order.

#
# Notes
# Notes

Indices: 1, 2, 3
Explicit map: [[1, 1], [3, 2]]

In explicit mode, only listed pairs are matched. Unlisted sections remain unpaired, including preambles. Repeated indices or unknown indices are errors, not guesses. If you insert a new heading, regenerate the chapter inventory and review the mapping.

What is counted

The supported subset is ATX headings with up to three leading spaces, backtick or tilde fences, standalone $$ blocks, and simple inline image/link destinations. Fenced code and equation content cannot create headings. Code languages, image targets and link targets are compared as multisets: repeated objects matter, but their order does not. Every recognized heading begins a new section; objects under a subheading belong to that subheading rather than being counted again in its parent.

What is deliberately not parsed

This is not a full CommonMark parser. Setext headings, reference-style links, nested-parenthesis destinations, raw HTML, inline math, tables and deeply nested Markdown constructs are outside the contract. Unclosed fences or equation blocks are not syntax-linted. Normalize those constructs or inspect them manually before relying on the report.

A changed URL can be a legitimate localized resource; equal block counts can conceal missing meaning. Use the output to choose what to read, never to score translation quality or certify completeness.

zh-Hant.title: 章節索引要穩定，不必要求翻譯後的標題同字
zh-Hant.description: 解讀報告前，先了解空標題、重複標題、前言與有限的 Markdown 語法範圍。
zh-Hant.body:
工具用遇見章節的順序作為識別，不用標題 slug。這樣不會假裝不同語言的標題必須同字，也能清楚區分重複標題。

索引規則

支援的 ATX 標題依序取得 1、2、3 等索引，包括巢狀標題。空標題 # 仍有獨立索引，在 Markdown 報告中顯示為「(untitled)」。兩個「Notes」是不同章節。第一個標題之前若有非空內容，屬於索引 0；空白文件沒有章節。預設模式只將前言 0 與另一份文件的前言 0 配對，其餘標題按出現順序配對。

#
# Notes
# Notes

索引：1、2、3
明確映射：[[1, 1], [3, 2]]

明確映射模式只處理列出的配對；未列出的章節，包括前言，都保持未配對。重複索引或不存在的索引會報錯，不會猜測。插入新標題後，應重新查看章節清單並調整映射。

實際計數的內容

支援子集包括最多三個前導空格的 ATX 標題、反引號或波浪號程式碼圍欄、獨立行 $$ 區塊，以及簡單的行內圖片與連結目標。程式碼與公式內部不會產生標題。程式語言、圖片目標和連結目標按多重集合比對：重複次數重要，順序不重要。每個標題都開始新章節；子標題下的物件歸該子節，不向上重複累計。

刻意不解析的語法

這不是完整 CommonMark 解析器。Setext 標題、參照式連結、目的網址內的巢狀括號、原始 HTML、行內公式、表格與複雜巢狀語法不在範圍內。未閉合的程式碼或公式區塊也不做語法 lint。依賴報告之前，應先正規化這些寫法或人工檢查。

網址變更可能是合理的本地化；區塊數量相同也可能隱藏語意遺漏。輸出只能協助決定先閱讀哪一段，不可用於翻譯品質評分或完整性認證。
